name: a-days-failure-is-not-anothers
find:
dayFailures[DaySlot(eventID: eventID, day: day)] = reason
        endDayRegen(day, for: eventID)
replace:
dayFailures = [DaySlot(eventID: eventID, day: day): reason]
        endDayRegen(day, for: eventID)
breaks: one day's rebuild failure erases every other day's, which is the shared status field #721 was filed about: whichever action failed last is the only reason Dan can read (L53)
